# 500.00 USD bought into A at 1.30, dated 2034-01-05 — before the 2034-01-10
# transfer out of A — and imported after it.
#
# By date, A held 500.00 when the transfer moved 500.00 out, so the transfer
# borrowed nothing. But the transfer was read against A's balance when it was
# imported, when A held nothing, and recorded 500.00 owed on A and 500.00 held
# on B; nothing reads it again. The book then keeps cost bases of 2,000.00 held
# against 1,500.00 its accounts hold, and 500.00 owed against nothing owed, and
# `--verify-integrity` reports both. Q-047 records it.
#
# Imported into the book usd_moved_out_of_an_empty_account.txt makes.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_balance_past_zero_has_a_cost_basis_on_the_other_side.py.
2034-01-05 * "Buy 500.00 USD at 1.30 into A"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD A 500.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "650.00"
	Assets:CAD Bank -650.00 CAD
